_doc-black.$description: Black theme — a semantic-layer override set. Emitted by the css-semantic-black Style Dictionary platform into apps/operator/app/_semantic.black.css under the [data-theme="black"] selector. THEME CONTRACT: every key here MUST be a base semantic token (it overrides the :root value from desktop.semantic.tokens.json); never a brand primitive (color.*) or a raw literal var. Only tokens that DIFFER from frost are listed — everything else (the bg-2/3/4 white-alpha tiers, --frost, status hues, --card-shadow) inherits :root, which is theme-neutral on black. Mirrors THEME_TOKENS in apps/operator/lib/theme.ts.

bg-deepest.$description: Deep surface tiers collapse to pure black on the black page

bg-raised.$description: Solid raised panel — subtle grey elevation above the black page (frost: bespoke navy)

bg-raised-high.$description: Solid raised emphasis/hover panel — one step lighter than --bg-raised

border.$description: Neutral border (replaces the sky-tinted frost border)

accent.$description: Light-grey accent so interactive chrome stays visible on black

accent-rgb.$description: RGB triplet of --accent for rgba() alpha composition — every theme that overrides accent must override this too, or the frost sky triplet leaks through :root

accent-strong-rgb.$description: RGB triplet of --accent-strong for rgba() alpha composition (same leak rule as accent-rgb)

accent-soft.$description: Light grey — glows/highlights go monochrome on black (frost: sky-200)

accent-soft-rgb.$description: RGB triplet of --accent-soft for rgba() alpha composition (same leak rule as accent-rgb)

accent-deep.$description: Mid grey — deeper accent tint on black (frost: sky-500)

accent-deeper.$description: Dark grey — deepest accent tint on black (frost: sky-700)

accent-ink.$description: Black text drawn on top of an accent fill
